spanish: Y los derribamos; pereció Jeshbón hasta Dibón, y desolamos hasta Nófaj, que hasta Medevá.

findings.issue: Qal sequential imperfect 1cp of H3384 (throw/shoot/cast) with a 3mp object suffix is rendered as derribar (knock down/overthrow), a different action than the lemma licenses. The suffix itself is kept as los.

notes: H6, the three H5704, hiphil H8074, H834, and the four proper names match the tokens.
